granularity_rationale: UK GDPR is listed at article level plus numbered paragraphs (art:N, art:N(P)) and recitals (recital:N; the UK text retains the 173 recitals as a preamble). The Data Protection Act 2018 is listed at section level plus numbered subsections (sec:N, sec:N(S)), schedules (sch:N) and numbered schedule paragraphs (sch:N(P)). Lettered points ((a), (b)) and sub-paragraphs are not listed: they are accepted when their parent is listed. This is the finest level at which a UK audit finding is usually cited (e.g. 'Article 32(1)', 'section 170(1)') and it is reliably numbered in the official XML. Provisions the source marks Repealed or Prospective (not yet in force) are excluded; paragraphs repealed inside a live provision carry no marker and are kept. Amending Annexes 1-2 of the UK GDPR are not listed. Identifiers the shared grammar cannot express (sch:a1) are omitted.
